info.sub_ename: CIVIL LAW: PARTICULAR KINDS OF OBLIGATIONS

description.sub_ename: CIVIL LAW: PARTICULAR KINDS OF OBLIGATIONS
description.describe_ch: 介紹民法債編中各種之債的相關規定內容。課程內容包括買賣、互易、交互計算、贈與、租賃、借貸、僱傭、承攬、出版、委任、經理人及代辦商、居間、行紀、寄託、倉庫、運送營業、承攬運送、合夥、隱名合夥、指示證券、無記名證券、終身定期金、和解、保證等特殊性質的債權債務關係。
description.describe_eh: The course introduces the particular kinds of civil obligations in Civil Law. Topics include sales, barter, account stated, gift, lease, loan, hiring, publication, mandate, brokerage, bailment, warehousing, carriage, agency, partnership, orders of payment, bearers, life annuity, compromise, and suretyship; etc.

targets.describe_ch: 能定義民法債編「各種之債」有關規定內容，所關注重點，是在使學生有解決法律糾紛能力。
targets.describe_en: Students would be able to define the civil law: Particular Kinds of Obligations in specific types of contract. The course is intended to make students acquainted with "the various ways" the competing doctrines are applied, and the interpretive technicali

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明民法各種債之關係之主體、雙方權利義務關係之內容，以及其他相關類型化契約。
targets.describe_en: Understand and be able to explain the obligations in specific types of contract in Civil Law

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識出可適用於民法債篇的案件，並能清楚表達其法律關係。
targets.describe_en: Distinguish and make clear statement where a case can be applied to the Obligations in civil law, and what the law relation is.

targets.describe_ch: 能使用相關法律規定、教科書，完成分析有關債權爭議案件的法律爭點，並由案件中歸納出適當結論。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use related legal provision and textbook to finish an analyses about the dispute of obligations, and draw appropriate conclusions from cases.
